key_path: `npx @posthog/wizard@latest --signup --email you@example.com --region us` - creates account + project via provisioning API (OAuth 2.0 + PKCE), writes project API key + host into the codebase, installs SDK
First events flow immediately (project key phc_ is client-safe)
`npx @posthog/wizard mcp add` installs remote MCP (https://mcp.posthog.com/mcp, OAuth) into Claude Code/Cursor/VS Code/etc.
Later: human sets password from welcome email to use web app; personal API key (scoped, 'MCP Server' preset) only if needed for REST scripts
human_gates: interactive_wizard (--ci mode disabled in published builds)
email_verification only to set a password / log in to the web app later

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: yes - wizard OAuth/PKCE login for existing accounts; PostHog CLI for error tracking/sourcemaps
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes - authorization server metadata at us.posthog.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server with registration_endpoint /oauth/register/ and CIMD support; MCP routes US/EU automatically; API returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata; publishes https://us.posthog.com/auth.md manifest (WorkOS auth.md profile) listing signup + auth methods + scopes; ID-JAG (XAA) for Enterprise beta
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes - Provisioning API for partners creates accounts/projects and returns project API keys
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes - personal API keys with per-scope + per-project restriction and presets
agent_native_auth.test_credentials_sandbox: no sandbox needed - free tier is the sandbox
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes - generous monthly free tier (1M events etc.), no card

mcp.product_mcp_remote: https://mcp.posthog.com/mcp, Streamable HTTP, OAuth (or personal API key with MCP Server preset); read/write across analytics, flags, experiments, errors, SQL, CDP
mcp.docs_mcp: docs tools included in the MCP
mcp.one_click: `npx @posthog/wizard mcp add` auto-installs into PostHog Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, VS Code, Zed; `claude plugin install posthog`; PostHog AI plugin for Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/Gemini CLI; Lovable/Replit/v0 integrations

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://posthog.com/llms.txt (440KB, opens with wizard + MCP instructions)
docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - every docs page at .md with 'AI agents: this is one page...' header
docs_for_agents.openapi: yes - OpenAPI schema served by the app; docs on generating SDKs with OpenAPI
docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: auth.md manifest; agent skills; wizard writes rules into projects

time_to_first_call_notes: One wizard command produces account, project, key and instrumented code; MCP add is a second command + OAuth click.
fully_autonomous_notes: Account + project key are created without email verification or any form; only caveat is the wizard must run interactively (CI mode disabled), and MCP requires a consent click.
agent_friendliness_justification: Agent-initiated signup with no form, standards-based discovery chain (401 -> RFC 9728 -> RFC 8414 -> auth.md), DCR+CIMD OAuth MCP with region routing, provisioning API, scoped keys and a free tier.
best_practice: Machine-discoverable auth: an unauthenticated 401 points to protected-resource metadata, which leads to an auth.md manifest describing how to sign up and authenticate - no hardcoded endpoints.
biggest_gap: Signup wizard cannot run headless (--ci disabled) and the signup path does not mint a personal API key for REST use.
